notes.title: Gardens Of Celestial Globes v0.1 | Early Access on Steam now!
notes.notes:
Features of the 0.1 version:
Up to 4 players at once, QUEST mode.
10 races, 10 attacks, 10 celestial vaults (towns).
9 location types, 20 level templates, random world generator.
All 77 creatures (without AI) and 181 map objects (mostly without actions).
Creep-farm, base-building, PvP fightings, ambient sounds, access to the final version.
